exposure: postpartum surgical sterilization after preterm delivery
adequacy of time for sterilization decision
adequacy of information for sterilization decision
adequacy of emotional support for sterilization decision
outcome: decision regret related to postpartum surgical sterilization
cohort: Adult pregnant patients who experienced a spontaneous or iatrogenic preterm delivery between March 15, 2011, and May 10, 2014, and underwent postpartum female surgical sterilization within 12 weeks of delivery.
finding: Most participants (75.5%) with a preterm delivery reported no or mild regret associated with their sterilization, and providing adequate time for patients to decide on postpartum surgical sterilization was the most important factor for decreased regret.
